GenAiFunction.description: Saves the answer to the current personalisation question (employment, company, income, purpose, amount) and returns the next question or the offer. Always pass journeyId = the journeyId output of the most recent LoanSeva action in this conversation (empty on the first call) and sessionId = the Routable Id (MessagingSession Id) of this conversation; leave sessionId empty if no Routable Id is available.
